name: Road Trip to Hell
source:
You and your husband decide to go on a road trip. A very  long road trip, at that. Then the two of you stop off at a gas station because of your random cravings. Shenanigans ensue from there!!!

Neither of you two know how much your actions are gonna change the course of so many people's lives...

[From [url=https://liminace.itch.io/road-trip-to-hell]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你和你的丈夫决定去公路旅行。这是一次非常漫长的公路旅行。然后你们两个因为随意的渴望而在加油站停下来。恶作剧从那里开始！

你们两个都不知道你们的行为将在多大程度上改变很多人的生活……

[来自[url=https://liminace.itch.io/road-trip-to-hell]itch.io[/url]]
